turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I finally fixed that annoying bug in the login flow. Took me hours but it's working now.
Glad to hear that, Alan. Good job sticking with it. Did you find out what caused it?

Yeah, just a missing null check. Anyway, switching gears—I've been looking into ways to tighten up our data handling. A type whitelist should be implemented in the fact_relate MCP tool as an immediate recommendation.
That sounds like a solid defensive measure to prevent unexpected data types from causing issues.
Exactly. I'll put it on the ticket. Oh, did the package for the new monitor arrive?
I don't have access to your shipment status, but you might want to check the tracking link you shared earlier.
Right, forgot I sent that. Thanks. I'm thinking of grabbing Thai food for dinner tonight.
Sounds delicious. Do you have a specific restaurant in mind?
Lloyd, the weather is absolutely miserable here. Pouring rain all day.
Sorry to hear that, Alan. Hope you're staying dry indoors.

I am. I've been digging into why our Knowledge Graph is getting so messy. It turns out The fact_relate MCP tool is identified as the root cause of the explosion in distinct edge types in the Knowledge Graph.
That's a significant finding. It explains why the graph complexity has been growing uncontrollably.
Yeah, it's a lot to clean up. I need to figure out a patch. By the way, did you manage to book that meeting with Sarah?
Yes, the meeting is confirmed for Thursday at 2 PM.
Great. I'll prepare the slides. Also, I left my charger on the desk, can you remind me to grab it before I leave?
Noted. I will remind you before your usual end-of-day time.
